The response answers both questions correctly. Mauna Kea rises about 10,200 m from its seafloor base, more than Everest's height above sea level, so Everest is not the tallest from base to peak. Chimborazo's summit is the point farthest from Earth's centre, about 2 km beyond Everest's peak, because of the equatorial bulge.
